subject: SIG/CAIQ Q&A: Third‑party Reconciliation & Evidence Delivery Plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <risk@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ Q&A: Third-party Reconciliation & Evidence Delivery Plan

Elena,

Thanks for sending over the SIG/CAIQ intake. To streamline the process we've consolidated our current subprocessor roster and an initial SIG answers tracker (attached) so you can see ownership and targeted delivery dates.

High-level plan:
- Today: share roster + answers tracker (attached)
- By 2026-06-04: provide SOC 2 scoping note and SOC 2 bridge statement (if requested)
- By 2026-06-11: deliver artifact bundle (evidence_delivery_manifest.pdf) for items marked 'high priority'

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm whether Novamed requires CAIQ v4 or CAIQ Lite? That will change the depth of mapping.
2) Any constrained evidence windows (procurement cutoffs / audit start dates) we should prioritize?

Attachments:
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx (master roster with vendor role & region)
- sig_answers_tracker.xlsx (working tracker with column for Novamed required evidence)

If helpful we can set a 30-minute sync this week to align owners—Kimberly and Marissa (cc'd) will lead the pull.

Thanks,

Rafael
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Gomez <risk@novamed.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ Q&A: Third-party Reconciliation & Evidence Delivery Plan

Rafael / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments — very helpful. A couple quick notes from Novamed risk/procurement: 

- We need CAIQ v4 outputs where possible; CAIQ Lite is acceptable for non-critical infra vendors (labelled in roster as "infra-minor").
- Our audit window is the week of 2026-06-20; anything you can get to us by 2026-06-11 will be prioritized for the SOC 2 evidence bundle.

Specific asks:
1) In the roster, can you mark which subprocessors have access to PHI or tokenized PII so we can apply the right controls?
2) For vendors with cross-region processing (US/EU), we need residency statements and KMS ownership notes.

I've attached Novamed_Security_Checklist.xlsx with the fields we plan to verify — please populate the tracker and return by EOD 2026-06-04 if possible.

If a sync is easier, I can make time Thursday morning (your timezone).

Best,
Elena Gomez
Head of Vendor Risk — Novamed Health

> Elena,

Elena — thanks for the checklist. We're aligning owners internally and here's a proposed evidence pullplan (short):

Owners & scope:
- Marissa Cole: infra & hosting vendors (KMS, cloud, telemetry). Primary deliverable: residency statements + KMS flow diagrams. Target: 2026-06-07.
- Jonas Weber: application/3rd-party integrators (analytics, monitoring). Primary deliverable: CAIQ mappings + evidence attachments. Target: 2026-06-09.
- Kimberly Park: contract & controls (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls). Primary deliverable: SOC2 scoping note + controls mapping. Target: 2026-06-04.

Action items for Novamed (we can take these as prerequisites):
- Confirm CAIQ v4 requirement (Elena indicated v4 for critical vendors).
- Return the populated Novamed_Security_Checklist.xlsx or grant us edit access on the tracker in Drive (link below).

Proposed meeting:
- 30 min sync: Thu 2026-06-03 09:00 PT (we can shift if that doesn't work).

DocuSign / SOW: We may need a short SOW addendum for evidence delivery (standard practice for larger bundles). Rafael / legal will propose language if Novamed confirms.

Drive link for trackers & upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2C3dE_fG

Kimberly
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

- 12 vendors marked as PHI-touching; those have highest priority and will be delivered by 2026-06-07.
- Cross-region processors (US/EU): residency statements included; KMS ownership notes in progress (Jonas owns).
- CAIQ v4 mapping: Jonas will deliver mappings for all medium/high risk vendors by 2026-06-09.

Attachments to this message:
- evidence_delivery_manifest.pdf (roll-up of items we will push into Novamed's evidence bucket)
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx (updated with PHI flag and owner columns)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the Thu 2026-06-03 09:00 PT sync or propose an alternative.
2) If Novamed prefers, we can start by providing a DocuSign-backed access agreement for the evidence bundle; link to a draft will be posted to the Drive and a DocuSign invite can follow.

Happy to walk through the manifest on the sync.

Thanks,
